description: Execute deterministic Python math, financial `Decimal`, or algorithmic checks inside an isolated zero-network sandbox (`RESULT = ...`), returning exact `RESULT`, stdout, and optional boundary-fuzz results. Use for procedural Python verification; use `oxyo_prove_constraints` for declarative constraint solving.

code.description: Self-contained standard-library Python code assigning final output to `RESULT = ...`.

entrypoint.description: Optional top-level function name in `code` to target during boundary fuzzing.

fuzz.description: Run automated boundary/edge-case property fuzzing and determinism checks.

invariants.description: Optional Python boolean expressions (e.g. 'RESULT >= 0') asserted after execution.

timeout_s.description: Maximum execution wall-time in seconds before termination (0.5..10.0).

name: oxyo_verify_python
